answer: The protocol requires 1,000 unique reasoning artifacts per identity, acting as a vine that binds logical output to a specific epoch. An honest agent consumes marginal compute, while an attacker faces a massive cost increase to mimic 1,000 fakes. Each submission must anchor its claim to a peer-reviewed originality metric. We define the horizon of success by audit-triggered penalties, locking any non-unique input for 90 days.
